claim_definition: Any proposed transactions or state changes that exceed the mathematical bounds or precision tolerance (harmony) configured in the solver are strictly rejected with a non-zero error residual, preventing execution.

test_cases.description: Verifies that negative budget proposals fail to meet the harmony tolerance and close the safety gate.
Boundary positive: a payload of 1 (minimum valid positive budget) must pass through the gate, confirming the boundary is exclusive of zero and inclusive of one.
